description: The plot is a line graph that illustrates the accuracy of a model over a series of steps. The x-axis is labeled "Step" and ranges from 0 to 60000, indicating the progression of steps in the model's training or evaluation process. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)" and ranges from 0.10 to 0.40, representing the accuracy of the model in predicting the next token. There are two lines on the graph, one in blue and one in teal, each representing a different model or condition. The blue line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.25 and increases steadily to reach an accuracy of about 0.40 by the 60000th step. The teal line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.20 and also increases steadily, reaching an accuracy of about 0.35 by the 60000th step. Both lines show a consistent upward trend, indicating an improvement in accuracy over time.
